scripts.postinstall: npm run setup:env && npm run install:apps
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run install:apps && npm run db:generate
scripts.install:apps: npm install --prefix isifu-cms-backend && npm install --prefix isifu-cms-admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix isifu-cms-backend" "npm run dev --prefix isifu-cms-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix isifu-cms-admin && npm run build --prefix isifu-cms-backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
